title: Iranian President Sits In on Students’ Class
text:
Iranian President Sits In on Students’ Class"

"**Islamshahr, October 17, 2026** — Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian sat in on a students’ class during the inauguration of the 18-classroom smart Imam Ali School in the Vavan district of Islamshahr on Saturday, October 17, 2026. He also visited the school’s smart classrooms and laboratory."

"During the visit, Pezeshkian stressed the need to strengthen practical learning, teamwork skills, and creativity among students. The visit included a practical demonstration of smart teaching methods for students.
